jobs.description: Take your technical expertise across Europe Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer with a strong mechanical background and a passion for solving complex technical problems? For an international manufacturer of advanced packaging machinery, Xelvin is looking for a Field Service Engineer who will support customers within the food and beverage industry. You will install, maintain and improve high-quality packaging machines at customer locations across Europe. This position offers a high level of independence, international travel and the opportunity to develop into a technical specialist within a global organisation. The preferred location for this position is the south of the Netherlands, such as North Brabant or Limburg, or the north of Belgium, including East Flanders, Antwerp or Limburg. What will you be doing? As a Field Service Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for customers. You will ensure that their packaging machines operate safely, reliably and efficiently. Your responsibilities will include: Performing professional service, maintenance and repairs on existing packaging machines. Installing, assembling and commissioning new machines at customer locations. Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical and automation-related malfunctions. Carrying out machine modifications, upgrades and conversions. Providing both on-site and remote technical support. Performing preventive maintenance to reduce downtime and improve machine availability. Monitoring machine performance and identifying potential technical issues at an early stage. Advising customers and sharing technical expertise to solve operational problems. Training customer employees in the correct operation and maintenance of the machinery. Preparing accurate service, quality and installation reports. Maintaining clear communication with customers and the Field Service Manager. Identifying possible commercial opportunities or risks during customer visits. Working closely with aexperienced and internationally oriented Field Service team. Most assignments will take place in the Benelux and Scandinavia. Depending on customer demand, you may also support customers in other parts of Europe. What can you expect from Xelvin? A gross monthly salary between €4,200 and €5,200, depending on your knowledge and experience. A company car, including private use. Paid overtime and 25 annual leave days. Training and career development opportunities. A complete relocation package when required, including a relocation budget, housing support, assistance with the 30% ruling, and support with arranging your BSN, bank account and health insurance. What do we expect from you? You are a practical and customer-focused engineer who enjoys working independently in an international service environment. You bring: At least five years of relevant experience as a Field Service Engineer, Mechatronics Engineer or Service Technician. Strong mechanical knowledge, as approximately 60% of the position is mechanically focused. Good electrical and automation knowledge, representing approximately 40% of the role. Experience with industrial machinery, production equipment or packaging machines. Experience with troubleshooting, commissioning and preventive maintenance. Knowledge of Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is an advantage. Knowledge of Bosch Rexroth servo systems is an advantage. Good written and spoken English. A valid driving licence. The willingness to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, Scandinavia and other parts of Europe. Availability to travel up to approximately 75% of your working time by car or aeroplane. Hier kom je te werken Our client is an internationally operating manufacturer of advanced packaging machinery and solutions. Its machines are used by leading companies within the food and beverage industry. The organisation focuses on innovation, reliability and long-term customer relationships. Work & Live in Greater Rotterdam The Hague  PhD Position in Ocean - Sea Ice Interactions (Delft, NL, 2628 CD) Delft University of Technology (TU Delft) Intern  Posted on Sep 22, 2026 Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. Job description The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica. Are you passionate about electronics, testing and automation, and eager to make a direct impact on the quality and manufacturability of high-tech products? Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT). Stromma has a history dating back to 1809 with a strong tradition of historic and cultural values. Today Stromma operates in 18 destinations in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands. Sustainability at Stromma Stromma focuses with its new strategy on sustainable tourism. Our vision is therefore: Northern Europe's leading sustainable producer and provider of tours and activities. Stromma Netherlands has been rewarded with the Green Key certificate. The burden on the environment is further limited by the increasing use of electricity to replace the current natural gas and hybrid diesel-electric engines.
